answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can transact, and make that stake grow with the volume it claims. A sybil operator planting an orchard of fake identities must fund each one, so creating ten thousand sock puppets costs ten thousand stakes. Let a terrace of reputation tiers unlock only after sustained, verified work — new accounts start at the bottom with tiny limits. A nebula of cheap clones then collapses under its own funding cost, because the deposit is slashed on proven abuse and the operator cannot recycle it to the next fake.
